items.item_text: At least 5 years of experience as a Dental Assistant and possess an active Registered Dental Assistant license that is in good standing.
Current Basic Life Support (BLS) certification from the AHA or ARC.
Current Sealant permit or obtain a sealant permit within 6 months of hire/reclassification.

Venice Family Clinic is a leader in providing comprehensive, high-quality health care to people in need regardless of their ability to pay or personal circumstance. The organization has more than 500 staff who serve 45,000 people with compassion, dignity, and respect across the Westside of Los Angeles, Inglewood, the South Bay, and everywhere in between. We have a network of clinics, Early Head Start centers, and mobile clinics plus an expansive street medicine program to reach people experiencing homelessness. Read more about us at venicefamilyclinic.org.

Come join our Venice Family Clinic team and make a difference in the communities we serve as a Registered Dental Assistant (RDA). Under the general supervision of the Senior Dentist, the RDA will coordinate patient flow and provide dental assistance in both clinical and community settings for our Venice Family Clinic's dental program. This role will also support the Virtual Dental Home (VDH) Program, which uses Tele-dentistry to provide comprehensive dental care.
Note this position is based in Santa Monica but will travel as needed to our other dental locations.
Current California Dental Board-approved courses in the California Dental Practice Act and Infection Control.

the final candidate who accepts an offer of employment will be required to disclose if they have been subject to any final administrative or judicial decisions within the last seven years determining that they committed any misconduct; or have filed an appeal of a finding of substantiated misconduct with a previous employer.
Working knowledge of current dental terminology, materials, equipment, and procedures related to dentistry.
Bilingual verbal skills in English and Spanish.
Working knowledge of principles of asepsis, sterilization procedures, and infection control.
Ability to organize and maintain an inventory of dental instruments, equipment, and supplies in the dental operatory.
Organizational skills to set priorities to reflect relative importance of job responsibility.
Ability to handle multiple demands and frequent interruptions and maintain a professional demeanor.
Ability to recognize emergency situations and respond appropriately.
Working knowledge of four-handed dentistry, and ability to work with infectious disease patients.
Skill in understanding both written and oral instructions.
Ability to take inventory.
Ability to stand for long periods of time.
Ability to maintain patient confidentiality and other HIPAA requirements.
